name: P07 — WHY: is the ease-behind's moving-gate seeing the boy, or only his REQUESTED velocity?

steps.note: W1. The instrument. The camera's gate is `moving = p.speed > 0.8` read from focus() = the player's SIM state. This samples BOTH the reported speed and the measured one, on the real clock, every frame. (step 14 once returned {} — JSON.stringify on a Promise stringifies it before the await, so the trace came back empty and the diagnosis was a false negative. Straight-return the object.)

steps.eval: (async()=>{const {Field}=await import('/src/world/field.js');const sim=()=>{const w=Field.world();return w&&w.player&&w.player.p?w.player.p:null;};window.__SIM=sim;window.__FACE=(d)=>{const w=Field.world();if(w&&w.player&&w.player.face)return w.player.face(d);return 'no face';};window.__REAL=(btn,ms)=>new Promise(res=>{const S=[];const t0=performance.now();__DQ.hold(btn);const tick=()=>{const c=__DQ.state().field.camera;const p=__DQ.state().player;const s=sim();S.push({t:+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(0),boom:c.boom,speed:p.speed,vx:p.vx,vz:p.vz,simSpeed:s?s.speed:null,simVX:s?s.vx:null,simVZ:s?s.vz:null,blocked:p.blocked,moving:p.moving,facing:p.facing,dist:c.dist});if(performance.now()-t0<ms)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else{__DQ.release(btn);res(S);}};requestAnimationFrame(tick);});window.__SUM=(s,lbl)=>{const d=(a,b)=>Math.abs(((a-b+540)%360)-180);const fin=s[s.length-1];const med=k=>{const v=s.map(x=>x[k]).filter(x=>x!=null).sort((a,b)=>a-b);return v.length?+v[Math.floor(v.length/2)].toFixed(3):null;};return{what:lbl,frames:s.length,boomTravel:+s.slice(1).reduce((a,v,i)=>a+d(v.boom,s[i].boom),0).toFixed(1),boomEnd:+fin.boom.toFixed(1),facingEnd:+fin.facing.toFixed(1),offByBehind:+d(fin.boom,(fin.facing+180)%360).toFixed(1),reportedSpeedMed:med('speed'),reportedSpeedMax:+Math.max(...s.map(v=>v.speed||0)).toFixed(2),simSpeedMed:med('simSpeed'),simSpeedMax:s.some(v=>v.simSpeed!=null)?+Math.max(...s.map(v=>v.simSpeed||0)).toFixed(2):null,framesOverGate:s.filter(v=>(v.speed||0)>0.8).length,framesSimOverGate:s.filter(v=>(v.simSpeed||0)>0.8).length,blockedFrames:s.filter(v=>v.blocked).length,distSpan:+(Math.max(...s.map(v=>v.dist))-Math.min(...s.map(v=>v.dist))).toFixed(3)};};return 'instrument ready';})()

steps.note: W2. THE REAL CLOCK, 2.6 s of 'right' — the case that left the camera 87 degrees out of date. If simSpeed is flat while reported speed is healthy, the gate is reading the wrong number.
W3. the same input, ONE SAMPLE PER SECOND, so the two speeds can be read side by side instead of as medians
W4. THE FROZEN CLOCK, identical input — the control that lands at 25 degrees
